title: Frontend implementation independent DAG template
objective: Replace with the concrete, bounded frontend implementation objective for this DAG run.
successCriteria: The contract covers every required user-visible behavior, state, and interaction.
The implementation is admitted only after a concrete, narrow writeSet is reviewed.
Static and behavior verification are recorded before final review.
The final closeout distinguishes passed, not-run, and residual-risk evidence.
globalConstraints: This is a self-contained static template: do not generate, import, or merge a DAG from a runtime builder before execution.
Replace every REPLACE/WITH/... placeholder with concrete repository paths or deterministic commands before execution.
Do not commit runtime traces under .harness/dag-runs/.
Every node must explicitly declare its executor; defaults.executor is schema-only and not a runtime fallback.
Only frontend-implement-pi may write project files, and only inside its concrete writeSet.
Read-only nodes must not write root artifacts/**; root artifacts/ is not a per-node scratchpad.
Do not infer missing behavior, states, interactions, design decisions, or verification commands. Stop for an explicit task-contract revision instead.
Do not add dependencies unless they are already declared by the project contract.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown frontend contract: required behavior, states, interactions, non-goals, concrete verification expectations, and unresolved gaps; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Read the task inputs. Produce a concise frontend contract that maps each required behavior, UI state, and interaction to observable outcomes. Identify missing or conflicting requirements as blockers; do not infer them and do not edit files.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown source and verification reconnaissance: relevant routes, components, styles, state patterns, focused tests, and risks; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Inspect only the declared frontend source and test paths. Report reusable component, styling, accessibility, state-management, and verification patterns that satisfy the contract. Do not edit files or broaden the allowed paths.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown implementation plan: ordered changes, concrete target files, behavior/state/interaction coverage, and focused verification mapping; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Turn the contract and reconnaissance into a minimal implementation plan. Every target file and verification step must be concrete. Preserve existing design and accessibility conventions. If any behavior lacks a verifiable target, report it as blocked instead of guessing.

tasks.outputContract: Archived deterministic design-policy result proving the plan uses declared dependencies, concrete requirements, and approved design evidence; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run the project-specific deterministic design-policy check selected for this task. It must reject missing requirement coverage, unauthorized dependencies, and unresolved design conflicts.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown design review: approved plan or explicit blocking findings for behavior, state, interaction, design-system, and accessibility coverage; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Review the approved plan against the frontend contract and design-policy result. Reject missing visible states, interaction behavior, accessibility obligations, or unsupported design claims. Do not edit files.

tasks.outputContract: Archived deterministic writer-admission result with a concrete, narrow writeSet and pre-write baseline; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run the project-specific writer-admission check. It must derive and record a concrete writeSet from the approved plan, reject broad paths and scope drift, and capture the pre-write baseline before authorizing the writer.

tasks.outputContract: Implementation summary with changed files, contract coverage, focused checks run, and residual risks.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Implement only the admitted frontend changes. Preserve established component, styling, accessibility, and state-management conventions. Cover every approved behavior, state, and interaction, then report changed files and focused verification. Do not broaden writeSet or add undeclared dependencies.

tasks.outputContract: Archived static and behavior verification output with command exit codes; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run the contract-selected deterministic static and behavior verification commands. Record all exit codes. A failed required command is terminal for this DAG run; do not silently substitute a different command.

tasks.outputContract: Archived deterministic final-review context: admitted writeSet, cumulative diff, and required verification evidence; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run the project-specific review-context collector. It must bind the admitted writeSet, actual cumulative diff, and required verification results so final review cannot rely on summaries alone.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown final review: approved result or explicit findings for contract coverage, regression risk, accessibility, and verification gaps; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Review the actual diff and archived verification evidence against the frontend contract. Do not treat missing, weak, mock-only, or not-run evidence as passed. Report explicit residual risks; do not edit files.

tasks.outputContract: Archived deterministic closeout summarizing contract coverage, verification status, review findings, evidence gaps, and residual risks; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run the project-specific deterministic closeout renderer. Preserve evidence status exactly: passed, failed, not-run, mock-backed, and baseline debt must never be promoted to a stronger result.
